basic_details.job_title: Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Young Professional, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola (Dr. PDKV) will hold a walk-in interview on 20 November 2026 at 1100 hrs onwards in the chamber of Head, Department of Soil Science, Dr. PDKV, Akola. The interview will fill one Young Professional II post (Rs. 35000/- consolidated per month) and one Project Assistant post (Rs. 20000/- consolidated per month), both adhoc posts on a contractual basis under a project sponsored by Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjeevani Praklpa (POCRA).

age_limit.details: The age limit for both posts is up to 38 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The age limit is relaxable as per University rule: | Category Relaxation SC/ST/NT 5 years OBC 3 years | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

qualification.details: The notice lists work experience and computer knowledge for each post in a column headed "Desirable", and the text in that column ends with the words "is essential". | Work experience in conduct of field trials. Work experience in soil and plant analysis and statistical analysis. Work experience in soil and plant sampling. Work experience in execution and monitoring of project activities. Knowledge of computer. | Work experience of soil, plant and manure testing. Work experience of soil and plant sampling. Work experience in execution and monitoring of project activities. Knowledge of computer. | The age limit for both posts is up to 38 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The age limit is relaxable as per University rule: | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.details: Chamber of Head, Department of Soil Science, Dr. PDKV, Akola
Rs. 35000/- (Young Professional II); Rs. 20000/- (Project Assistant), consolidated per month
Adhoc post on contractual basis under a POCRA-sponsored project
Up to 38 years, with relaxation for SC/ST/NT and OBC as per University rule
Candidates with M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy/ Soil Science (Young Professional II) or B.Sc. (Agriculture) (Project Assistant)

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists work experience and computer knowledge for each post in a column headed "Desirable", and the text in that column ends with the words "is essential". Work experience in conduct of field trials. Work experience in soil and plant analysis and statistical analysis. Work experience in soil and plant sampling. Work experience in execution and monitoring of project activities. Knowledge of computer. Work experience of soil, plant and manure testing. Work experience of soil and plant sampling. Work experience in execution and monitoring of project activities. Knowledge of computer. The age limit for both posts is up to 38 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The age limit is relaxable as per University rule: For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates should report on 20.11.2026 at 1100 hrs with: Original documents One set of self attested photocopies Latest passport size photograph For more information, the notice refers candidates to the university website, www.pdkv.ac.in .

faq.question: Q1. When is the Dr. PDKV Akola walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 20 November 2026 at 1100 hrs onwards.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is held in the chamber of Head, Department of Soil Science, Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 01 Young Professional II and 01 Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Young Professional II?
faq.answer: Young Professional II requires M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy/ Soil Science, along with the work experience and computer knowledge listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Project Assistant requires B.Sc. (Agriculture), along with work experience of soil, plant and manure testing, sampling, project activities and knowledge of computer.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 38 years for both posts.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets age relaxation and how much?
faq.answer: SC/ST/NT candidates get 5 years and OBC candidates get 3 years of relaxation, as per University rule.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Young Professional II gets Rs. 35000/- and Project Assistant gets Rs. 20000/-, both consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring original documents, one set of self attested photocopies and a latest passport size photograph.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No, both are adhoc posts on a contractual basis under the POCRA-sponsored Conservation Agriculture project.
